summary: Stand-up desk assembly, inbound peripheral hold at warehouse dock, and temporary badge sync for contractor
description:
Issue summary: New contractor start scheduled 2026-03-11 requires assembly of a sit-stand desk (order #RDW-55218) and delivery of peripherals (monitor arm, keyboard tray). Shipment arrived to Redwood warehouse dock and has been placed on hold by the warehouse partner due to missing 'receive-to-desk' tag and mismatch on packing manifest. Temporary badge for contractor (badge request CR-9007) did not sync to building turnstiles overnight.

Impact: Contractor onboarding delayed; desk and peripherals cannot be staged to the assigned 2nd-floor bay. Hiring manager and IT onboarding are awaiting same-day assembly. Badging failure prevents contractor from accessing reception and staging area. No customer-facing impact.

Environment: Redwood SF office (onsite), warehouse partner: West Coast Logistics (WCL) dock B, scheduled move window 2026-03-11 09:00-12:00 PST.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Verify WCL manifest for order RDW-55218 shows 'receive_to_desk' flag absent
2) Attempt to mark shipment as 'released' in Odoo -> returns 'invalid destination code'
3) Confirm badge provisioning API returns 200 but building access logs show no swipe provisioning for badge CR-9007
4) Reception reports contractor could not be admitted at 08:45 on 2026-03-11
logs: badge_api_2026-03-11T03:01:12Z: 200 OK - provision request queued (trace id 7f3a2b)
turnstile_log_2026-03-11T08:46:09Z: badge CR-9007 not found in directory
comments: Maya Chen (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Raised after WCL flagged missing tag; contractor start is tomorrow morning. Asking for expedited handling and temporary access for staging.
Liam Ortega (Assignee) 2026-03-10: Acknowledged. I will reach out to WCL ops and facilities to request immediate hold release and check Odoo mapping. Also escalating badge sync to Identity team.

Facilities lead (Priya Kapoor) 2026-03-11: WCL confirmed they will accept a corrected manifest by 10:00 PST and can stage to Bay 12 instead of Bay 24 if we supply a valid desk tag. Can staging team assemble at 11:30 if access issues are resolved.

Identity (Carlos Mendes) 2026-03-11: Badge provisioning system shows a race: badge created in HR but directory sync to building controller failed due to rate limit. Increased job concurrency and requeued badge; expected propagation by 09:30 PST.

Liam Ortega 2026-03-12: Follow-up - WCL released shipment to Bay 12 at 10:18. Staging assembled the desk at 11:40. Contractor admitted with temporary visitor pass. Keeping ticket open for permanent badge verification and to reconcile Odoo destination codes.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: Packing manifest omitted 'receive_to_desk' tag due to manual entry from vendor portal (WCL). Confirmed; vendor uploaded incorrect CSV with column shift.
Hypothesis 2: Odoo mapping for DESK-BAY-24 had been deprecated last quarter and not remapped to Bay 12. Found mapping gap in 'warehouse_locations' table. Patch prepared to add alias mapping.
Identity issue: Badge creation succeeded but building controller sync job throttled by rate limiter configured on 2026-02-01. Rate limit lifted for onboarding window; requeued job succeeded on retry.
Risk noted: If manifest issues persist for future shipments, recurring delays will occur. Recommend validation webhook from Odoo to vendor portal to reject manifests missing destination_tag.
Related artifact: small script created to transform vendor CSVs into expected schema; stored in /repos/facilities/tools/manifest_normalizer (PR pending).
resolution: Partial workaround implemented: WCL accepted corrected manifest and staged equipment to Bay 12; facilities crew assembled desk at 11:40 on 2026-03-11. Contractor admitted using temporary visitor pass until badge directory propagation confirmed. Permanent fix: added alias mapping for DESK-BAY-24 to Bay 12 in Odoo and submitted PR for manifest_normalizer to vendor portal. Identity team adjusted sync concurrency and confirmed badge CR-9007 visible to building controllers on 2026-03-11 09:22. Follow-ups: merge manifest_normalizer PR, add vendor-side CSV validation webhook, and document updated receiving checklist in Confluence. Closing after follow-up items scheduled.
next_steps: 1) Merge PR #284 in facilities/tools to normalize vendor manifests (owner: Liam Ortega, due 2026-03-15)
2) Create a validation webhook ticket for Vendor Integration team (INT-76445) to reject manifests missing destination_tag
3) Update Receiving Runbook with 'Bay alias' section and notify WCL account manager
4) Confirm permanent badge activation with Identity and mark this ticket Resolved once confirmed (target 2026-03-15)
